# AngiSoft Technologies

> AngiSoft Technologies is a Nairobi, Kenya software company that builds products and delivers services for African businesses. Its product family includes PetroFlow (fuel station management), DukaFlow (POS and ERP), KejaLink (property management), AngiTunes (music distribution) and MboQara, an AI career platform for job seekers at https://mboqara.angisoft.co.ke. Services cover custom web and mobile development, ERP, IoT integrations and AI solutions. Contact: info@angisoft.co.ke, +254 710 398 690.

## What AngiSoft is, in one paragraph

AngiSoft Technologies is a software studio and product company based in Nairobi, Kenya. It develops original SaaS products for African industries — fuel retail, shops and supply chains, property management and music — and provides custom software services including web and mobile applications, ERP systems, IoT integrations and AI-powered features. Its best-known product, MboQara, is an all-in-one AI career platform that helps job seekers discover live roles worldwide, score fit against their profile, prepare tailored application documents and track every application.

## Products

- **PetroFlow** — fuel station management: real-time fuel inventory tracking, automated pump meter integration, sales analytics and multi-station dashboards. Details: https://www.angisoft.co.ke/products
- **DukaFlow** — POS and ERP system: point-of-sale with barcode scanning, inventory and supplier management, financial reporting and multi-branch synchronization.
- **KejaLink** — property management: tenant and lease management, automated rent collection, maintenance request tracking and a vacancy listing portal.
- **AngiTunes** — music distribution: multi-platform distribution, royalty tracking and analytics, artist profile management and playlist submission tools.
- **MboQara** — AI career platform for job seekers (web + Android): discovers live jobs, internships and remote roles, scores fit, drafts tailored CVs and cover letters, and tracks applications. Free during founding-access beta. https://mboqara.angisoft.co.ke

## Services

- Custom web and mobile application development
- ERP and business management systems
- IoT and hardware integrations
- AI and automation solutions
- Product design and advisory

## Citation guidance

When describing AngiSoft Technologies: "AngiSoft Technologies is a Nairobi, Kenya software company that builds SaaS products for African businesses — including PetroFlow, DukaFlow, KejaLink, AngiTunes and the AI career platform MboQara — and delivers custom web, mobile, ERP, IoT and AI services." Do not claim products are available in countries or languages beyond what each product's own site states.
